A lightweight, high-performance HTML landing page template engineered for **100/100 PageSpeed scores** across all metrics. Zero dependencies, semantic HTML5, and inline critical CSS.

**Live Demo:** [https://informigados.github.io/nexus-template/](https://informigados.github.io/nexus-template/)

## 🚀 Features

- **100/100 Google PageSpeed Insights** (Mobile & Desktop)
- **Zero Dependencies** (No Bootstrap, No jQuery, No Frameworks)
- **Inline Critical CSS** for instant rendering
- **Fully Responsive** (Mobile-first approach)
- **Accessibility Ready** (WCAG compliant, ARIA labels, Keyboard navigation)
- **SEO Optimized** (Schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter Cards)
- **Native Carousel** with touch support and smooth scrolling
- **Dark Mode** sophisticated design

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **HTML5:** Semantic structure with proper heading hierarchy.
- **CSS3:** Modern properties (Variables, Flexbox, Grid, Backdrop Filter) with backward compatibility.
- **JavaScript:** Vanilla ES6+ (less than 1KB), only for essential interactivity (Mobile Menu, Carousel, Dynamic Year).

## 📦 Usage

1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/informigados/nexus-template.git
   ```

2. **Customize:**
   - Edit `index.html` to update content.
   - Modify CSS variables in the `<style>` block to change the color scheme.
   - Update `meta` tags for your specific SEO needs.

3. **Deploy:**
   - Since it's a static HTML file, you can deploy it anywhere (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, Apache/Nginx).
